# bilibili-drum-score-to-pdf

Standalone Python/CLI and optional anonymous FastAPI website converting visible fixed-scale vertical drum score videos into A4 image PDFs. Public HTTPS Bilibili BV URLs and local files are supported by CLI; the website accepts public BV URLs only. No model generation, MIDI or Agent approval protocol. Complete means artifact publication, never musical proofreading; reliable=false.

Install with pip in a dedicated Python 3.12+ environment; native FFmpeg/ffprobe/Poppler are required. Website service lifecycle is Ubuntu/Linux-specific. Anonymous acquisition does not load cookies, netrc, downloader config, plugins or model credentials. Existing output is never overwritten.

Web results expire 24 hours after durable completion. The independent worker cleans intermediate media and expired managed files; unknown files and replaced identities are preserved. Original native samples are removed from web delivery, so its manifest cannot reconstruct the source. The website has local integration evidence, not public deployment or target-server hard-resource acceptance.

Old Skill distribution and approval/model workflows are retired. History and experiment evidence remain available in Git and docs/experiments. Original code/docs use MIT; music, notation and derived examples retain their owners' rights. See LICENSE and docs/media/readme/README.md.
